newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-SHEARER DISMISSES TALK LINKING HIM TO BARCELONA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SHEARER DISMISSES TALK LINKING HIM TO BARCELONA.

text.p: England striker Alan Shearer dismissed on Friday reports linking him with a transfer from Newcastle to Barcelona if Ronaldo completes his expected move from the Catalan club to Inter Milan.

Shearer, currently the world's most expensive player following his 15 million pounds sterling ($24.6 million) move from Blackburn to Newcastle United last July, said: "I'm linked with all sorts of moves and the first I get to hear about them is when I read about them in the press.
"Last year I signed a five-year contract with Newcastle, the first year has been very good and I would be surprised if I left before the end of that time.
"At the moment I am very happy and don't want to go abroad. But it is something I have considered and you can never say never. The football and the lifestyle would appeal to me.
"But there is also my two little girls and my wife to think of and although it might happen one day, I cannot see it happening at the moment."

As soon as Ronaldo moves, a transfer that now seems imminent following an open split between the striker and the club this week, the 20-year-old World Player of the Year is also set to beat Shearer's record as the world's most expensive player.
"I like having the tag of world's most expensive player and I don't particularly want to lose it" said the Englishman breaking off preparations for Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Poland.
But he added: "Records are made to be broken and it has to go someday."
